name: linear-synthetic
description: Linear bandit: 10 instances (1000 actions and theta uniform on the unit sphere of R^20, noise 0.1), 2 runs each. LinUCB and ConfidenceBall1 against arm buckets (LinUCB_AB), random projections (LinUCB_RP, CBRAP), sketches (SOFUL, CBSCFD) and LinTS. Theoretical defaults.

notices.title: Default hyperparameters
notices.text: Paper values: alpha=1 for all policies. Safe in theory, but they often explore too much.
notices.todo: Grid search: param_grid=True. Or set them, e.g. LinUCB(alpha=0.1).

notices.title: Arm buckets (heuristic)
notices.text: LinUCB_AB ranks the actions by UCB into buckets and searches one bucket per step. Faster, but it can miss the best action, and the regret bound no longer holds.
notices.todo: Compare with the same policy without n_buckets.

notices.title: Not stored
notices.text: Pseudo-regret, n_buckets and sketch_error over time, action of every step. The charts cannot show them.

notices.title: Curves stored every 15 steps
notices.text: Between two stored steps, the curve is drawn, not measured. You set log_interval=15.

notices.title: Slower timings
notices.text: Memory tracking (measure_memory=True) makes Python code about 5 times slower.
